name: Soft Rasterization
definition: An optimization helper that applies Gaussian blur to the rasterized output to enrich gradients and stabilize convergence by providing rich, non-vanishing gradients near primitive boundaries.
summary: Soft rasterization is a differentiable rendering technique that blends primitive contributions near edges to mitigate gradient vanishing and stabilize optimization, distinguishing itself from standard hard rasterization by yielding slightly distorted images.
